response.original_title: How to Add Another Room to My Royal Caribbean Cruise
response.overview: You can add a room to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruises booking by calling Royal Caribbean Cruise Customer Service at +1-888-669-0702 or contacting your travel agent. To add rooms to a Royal Caribbean Cruise, you must call Royal Caribbean Cruise directly at ☎ +1-888-669-0702(US/Canada) or 44-808-196-9697(UK) or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online. Additions depend on stateroom capacity, ship lifeboat capacity, and current availability ☎ +1-888-669-0702(US/Canada) or 44-808-196-9697(UK). The booking will likely be re-priced at current rates. To add someone to an existing Royal Caribbean Cruise room, you must call Royal Caribbean Cruise directly at ☎ +1-888-669-0702(US/Canada) or 44-808-196-9697(UK), or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done via the website or app.
